HAEM01|HMT-08.old:
**ISTH SCORE** | **0** | **1** | **2** | **3**
**Platelets (×10⁹/L)** | Over 100 | 50–100 | Under 50 |
**D-dimer or FDP** | No rise |  | Moderate | Strong
**PT prolonged (s)** | Under 3 | 3–6 | Over 6 |
**Fibrinogen (g/L)** | Over 1 | Under 1 |  | 
Overt DIC: ISTH **5 or more**; the Japanese (JMHW) score uses **4 or more**.
**Hyperfibrinolytic** (bleeding): APL. **Hypofibrinolytic** (thrombosis): ALL treated with **asparaginase**.
Fibrinogen over **1.5 g/L**; platelets over 20 if actively bleeding; treat the cause (ATRA). Asparaginase: lower platelet threshold (20–30), anticoagulate by platelet count, dexamethasone.
HAEM01|HMT-08.new:
**ISTH SCORE** | **0** | **1** | **2** | **3**
**Platelets (×10⁹/L)** | Over 100 | 50–100 | Under 50 |
**D-dimer or FDP** | No rise |  | Moderate (over **3×** upper normal) | Strong (over **7×** upper normal)
**PT prolonged (s)** | Under 3 | 3–6 | Over 6 |
**Fibrinogen (g/L)** | Over 1 | Under 1 |  | 
Overt DIC: ISTH **5 or more**; the Japanese (JMHW) score uses **4 or more**.
**Hyperfibrinolytic** (bleeding): APL. **Hypofibrinolytic** (thrombosis): ALL treated with **asparaginase**.
Fibrinogen over **1.5 g/L**; platelets over **50** if actively bleeding (APL: keep over 30–50); treat the cause (ATRA). Asparaginase: lower platelet threshold (20–30), anticoagulate by platelet count, dexamethasone.
HAEM01|HMT-08.why: Bleeding DIC needs platelets kept over 50 (ISTH 2013 harmonised guidance; ELN 2019 APL: 30-50), not 20; and the 2025 ISTH update fixed D-dimer bands at >3x ULN (2 points) and >7x ULN (3 points). Sources: Iba et al. JTH 2025;23:2356 (practical-haemostasis.com ISTH 2025 calculator); Wada et al. JTH 2013;11:761.
